description: Figure 3 is a pie chart that illustrates the inter-annotator agreement compared to sample-level ambiguity standard deviation and sample-level maximum ambiguity values. The chart is divided into four segments, each representing a different range of ambiguity standard deviation values: 0.0, 0.47, 0.82, and 0.94. The largest segment, representing 47.7%, corresponds to a standard deviation of 0.0, indicating the highest level of agreement among annotators. The next largest segment, at 38.0%, represents a standard deviation of 0.47. The segment for a standard deviation of 0.82 accounts for 14.2% of the chart, and the smallest segment, at 5.0%, corresponds to a standard deviation of 0.94. The chart is labeled with the title "Inter-annotator agreement compared to sample-level ambiguity standard deviation and sample-level maximum ambiguity values."
